description: Break a Cyprus salary into employer cost and employee deductions by fund, applying the three separate contribution ceilings correctly: insurable earnings for Social Insurance, Redundancy and Industrial Training, the total-income ceiling for GESY, and no ceiling for the Social Cohesion Fund. Income tax is not included.

holiday_fund.description: Add the Holiday Fund, payable where the employer does not run its own scheme.

name: cyprus_payroll_contributions
title: Calculate Cyprus employer cost and employee deductions on a salary
